task_instruction = "Like all the songs and albums in my Spotify song and album library, respectively, that I have not liked yet."
print('Task instruction:', task_instruction)

# Criteria enumeration gate
criteria = [
    {
        'Criterion': 'Songs: in your Spotify song library AND not currently liked',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'Like all the songs in my Spotify song library ... that I have not liked yet',
        'Implementation': 'song_id in library (show_song_library) AND song_id not in liked songs (show_liked_songs)'
    },
    {
        'Criterion': 'Albums: in your Spotify album library AND not currently liked',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'Like all the albums in my Spotify album library ... that I have not liked yet',
        'Implementation': 'album_id in library (show_album_library) AND album_id not in liked albums (show_liked_albums)'
    }
]
for c in criteria:
    print(c['Criterion'], '|', c['Implementation'])
print('Num criteria:', len(criteria))

# Login
spotify_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='as_moore@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']
print('Logged in. token length:', len(access_token))

PAGE_LIMIT = 20

# State transition pre-check: liked songs
liked_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=PAGE_LIMIT, sort_by='-liked_at')
    if not page:
        break
    liked_song_ids.update([s['song_id'] for s in page])
    page_index += 1

# Fetch library songs
library_song_items = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=PAGE_LIMIT, sort_by='-added_at')
    if not page:
        break
    library_song_items.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

songs_to_like_ids = [s['song_id'] for s in library_song_items if s['song_id'] not in liked_song_ids]
# Build song title map for verification
song_id_to_title = {s['song_id']: s['title'] for s in library_song_items}

# Print partition summary and verification tables
songs_already_liked = sorted(list(liked_song_ids & set(song_id_to_title.keys())))
print('Song pre-check: already in target state:', songs_already_liked, 'N=', len(songs_already_liked))
print('Song pre-check: need action:', sorted(songs_to_like_ids), 'M=', len(songs_to_like_ids))
print('Songs_to_like verification (id|title):', [(sid, song_id_to_title.get(sid)) for sid in sorted(songs_to_like_ids)])

# Albums state transition pre-check: liked albums
liked_album_ids = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_albums(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=PAGE_LIMIT, sort_by='-liked_at')
    if not page:
        break
    liked_album_ids.update([a['album_id'] for a in page])
    page_index += 1

# Fetch library albums
library_album_items = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=PAGE_LIMIT, sort_by='-added_at')
    if not page:
        break
    library_album_items.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

album_id_to_title = {a['album_id']: a['title'] for a in library_album_items}
albums_to_like_ids = [a['album_id'] for a in library_album_items if a['album_id'] not in liked_album_ids]

albums_already_liked = sorted(list(liked_album_ids & set(album_id_to_title.keys())))
print('Album pre-check: already in target state:', albums_already_liked, 'N=', len(albums_already_liked))
print('Album pre-check: need action:', sorted(albums_to_like_ids), 'M=', len(albums_to_like_ids))
print('Albums_to_like verification (id|title):', [(aid, album_id_to_title.get(aid)) for aid in sorted(albums_to_like_ids)])

# Store for next step
song_ids_delta = sorted(set(songs_to_like_ids))
album_ids_delta = sorted(set(albums_to_like_ids))
print('Final deltas -> songs:', song_ids_delta, 'albums:', album_ids_delta)
